name: gems60-convergence-ribbon6-20261011T155420Z
hypothesis: H60-C1 (session-5 cross-family convergence lane): at a fixed dot budget the official DTI is proportional to the precision of the emitted dots, so requiring *two independent physical families* (magnetic, isostatic-gravity, topographic, subsurface) to fire a consistent-strike lineament at the same pixel raises precision over any single-family ridge detector; and with the across-strike localization error measured at 2-4 px the optimal emission geometry is a dotted multi-line ribbon on the 3 px kernel-radius lattice, not a single line.
mechanism: the scoring kernel is a normalised triangular cap at R = 300 m = 3 px with alpha = 0.2, so a unit of emitted mass pays iff its kernel credit exceeds 0.2*DTI (0.052 at DTI 0.26): mass that lands inside the kernel is nearly free, mass that misses costs 0.2, and each truth pixel can be credited once. Magnetic/gravity/topographic/subsurface lineaments that agree in location and strike are far more likely to be a real planar discontinuity than a single-field lineament, and parallel dotted lines spaced at the kernel radius convert the measured localization error into kernel credit at the price of one dot per 3 px of along-strike length.
named_non_fault_process: aeromagnetic flight-line levelling/corrugation and the regional NE-SW Basin-and-Range lithological grain both produce lineaments no fault occupies; requiring two families to agree rejects most of these, but a levelling artefact that coincides in strike with a topographic or gravity grain can still pass the agreement test, which is why the agreeing count is used as a ranking weight and not as a fault call.

holdout_dti.label: HOLDOUT-DTI (catalogue recovery only; not a leaderboard forecast)
holdout_dti.protocol: buffered hide-and-recover, whole components, 3 px context collar
holdout_dti.ci_note: a DTI is a ratio of kernel-weighted masses, not a binomial proportion, so no defensible binomial CI exists for it; the four fold-level DTIs (this split contains one withhold per quadrant) and the Wilson interval on the pooled coverage are reported instead
holdout_dti.caveat: withheld truth is the mapped catalogue, while the competition scores the faults that are absent from the catalogue; this instrument is structurally blind to off-catalogue files (lane measurement: Spearman −0.037 between this proxy and live scores over 34 rasters)

sigma_table.evaluator: gems57.metric (kernel-only AUC/precision; no DTI claimed here)
sigma_table.unit: px (100 m pixels; the scoring kernel radius is 3 px)

leakage_canary.note: each feature family scored alone against the withheld catalogue truth

equal_budget_probe.caveat: this probe falsified the agreement gate as a *hard* gate: a single family (topographic) ranks at least as well at an equal 40k-dot budget, so agreement is used only as a ranking weight inside the allocator

pattern_selection.shipped_geometry: the emitted rasters carry the centre line plus parallel lines every RIBBON_LINE_SPACING_PX = 3.0 px, i.e. the sweep's 2.8 px column (bracketed by 3.5 px) rounded to the kernel radius; the dot lattice then enforces a >= 3 px minimum separation, which is why the sweep's tighter columns (1.5 / 2.0 px) are not realisable as separate lines
